subject.title: feat(cursor): add token cost report with Cursor-metered total

question: Should detailed Cursor dashboard event-history collection require a dedicated opt-in, or may enabling the existing cost summary automatically reuse the authenticated Cursor session?
rationale: The change broadens a cookie-authenticated status integration into collection of detailed account-wide history from a private endpoint, so consent and privacy behavior require repository-owner intent rather than an automated code choice.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Add a dedicated consent setting and keep detailed Cursor history disabled until the user knowingly enables the remote account-wide fetch.

options.title: Reuse cost-summary consent
options.body: Treat Show cost summary as sufficient consent, with prominent disclosure that Cursor data is remote and account-wide.

options.title: Decline remote history
options.body: Keep Cursor limited to summary status data and do not merge the detailed event-history integration.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Add a dedicated consent setting and keep detailed Cursor history disabled until the user knowingly enables the remote account-wide fetch.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner explicitly placed this implementation on a product/privacy hold and has already reviewed and contributed to the affected paths.
